paite: Mihai in alungsim in, "Pathian a-om kei," achi a. Akigawp khin ua, thilkihhuaitak ahih ua; thil hoih hih a-om kei uhi.
heading: Lapu Lian A Ding, David La / Mite Gitlouhna / (Sam 53)

paite: Theisiam a Pathian zong a-om uhiam, chi in TOUPA'N van a kipan in mihing tate a-ensuk hi.
Ahilou lam ah apial vekta ua, nintak in ana om chiatta ua; kuamah thil hoih hih a-om kei ua, khat lel leng a-om kei hi.
Thil hihkhialte tengteng in theihna himhim anei kei ua hia? Tanghou anek bang un ka mite a ne zou vek ua, TOUPA asam kei uhi.
Huai ah lau tuntun in a-om ua; Pathian, midiktat suante lak a a-om ziak in.
Mitasam suangtuahnate na selphou ua, TOUPA akihumbitna ahih ziak in.
Israelte hotdamna Zion a kipan in hong pawt mahleh aw! TOUPA'N amite sal a a-om uh apikik nawn chiang in, huai hun in Jakobte anuam ding ua, Israelte akipakta ding uhi.
